content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the inefficient handling of path components in the `globStatus` method, which led to excessive calls to `listStatus` and `getFileStatus`. This inefficiency could result in performance issues, especially when dealing with directories containing many files or when the file system has special directories that are not visible to `listStatus`. The patch optimizes the logic to minimize these calls by introducing checks to skip unnecessary status retrievals, particularly when there are no candidates left or when certain conditions about the path components are met.
